name: offmint
description: Offmint — weekend float vault for Robinhood Chain stock tokens (monorepo)

scripts.lint:contracts: cd contracts && forge fmt --check && forge lint src
scripts.test:keeper: npm run test -w keeper && npm run test -w backtest
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w keeper && npm run typecheck -w backtest
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run typecheck && npm run test:keeper
